incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=auth-signing (HIGH). 120 failures in last 3m, error rate 18%. incident-bot: Alert details: validation errors (JWT verify failed: kid mismatch / signature invalid) and 502s from signer-api-prod-*. Link: https://pd.company/p/INC-82741
pagerduty: Acknowledgement pending. Escalation policy: auth-oncall -> platform-eng -> eng-managers.
samir (on-call): Acked. I'm looking. Can someone post the stack/zone? Which clusters are showing errors?
maya (sre): Seeing spikes in eu-west and us-central. signer-api-prod-1 degraded. Logs show 429s from jwks-fetch and 502 from signer when verifying tokens. Full log tail:
```
ERROR signer verify: token=abc... kid="key-2025-09" expected_kid="key-2025-10" status=400 err="kid mismatch"
WARN jwks client: fetch failed status=502 url=https://keys.internal/auth/jwks err="upstream timeout"
```
alex (eng): That kid mismatch is interesting — we rolled new keys yesterday to key-2025-10. Are some envs still serving old keys or still reading old cached JWKS?
samir (on-call): On it. I'll query cache state and restart jwks-cache pods if needed. Starting runbook step 1: check JWKS propagation across regions.
ops-bot: runbook:auth-signing-step1: list pods with label app=jwks-cache -- command run by samir
samir (on-call): Results: eu-west jwks-cache replicas show older image tag (v1.3.2) on node-a, while us-central has v1.3.3. Possible staggered rollout. Fetching /keys endpoint on signer-api-prod-1:
```
curl -sS https://signer-api-prod-1.internal/keys | jq .keys[] | .kid
"key-2025-09"
```
samir (on-call): Confirmed: signer-api-prod-1 still serving key-2025-09. That explains the kid mismatch. Rolling restart signer-api-prod-1 to pick up new keys from KMS.
maya (sre): Noted customer impact: token validations failing for some customers in eu-west; Auth-heavy routes (login, api token validation) seeing increased latency/error. Slack thread with Customer Success: pinging.
lucy (product): FYI CS reports ~120 active user requests failing (mostly webhooks) and 3 enterprise customers with increased errors. Need an ETA and potential mitigation for customers (retry guidance).
alex (eng): Quick mitigation: enable fallback verification using previous key for 30m. Changing service config to accept both key-2025-09 and key-2025-10. Patching signer config now.
samir (on-call): Applying hotpatch to signer-config via k8s patch: `kubectl -n auth set env deploy/signer-api ACCEPT_KEY_KIDS=key-2025-09,key-2025-10` — patch applied. Restart done.
ops-bot: deploybot: restart deployment signer-api-prod-1 triggered by samir (on-call)
samir (on-call): Post-restart check: `/keys` now returns both kids.
```
curl -sS https://signer-api-prod-1.internal/keys | jq .keys[] | .kid
"key-2025-10"
"key-2025-09"
```
maya (sre): Error rate dropping; now 2% over last 5m. Latency back to baseline for most regions. Monitoring closely for 30m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledgement recorded by samir (on-call). Incident status: acknowledged -> action in progress.
pagerduty: Note: auto-escalation paused due to ack.
lucy (product): Notifying CS to tell affected customers: short blip in token validation while keys rotated; we recommend retrying requests. Sending templated note.
alex (eng): Will follow up with a better rollout plan for JWKS: must ensure key rollout orchestration waits for full JWKS propagation before cutover. Adding a guard to CI/CD.
samir (on-call): Leaving handoff note: I'll continue monitoring for 15m, then hand to maya if stable. Add to incident tracker: https://incidents.company/2798765432
maya (sre): Taking 15m watch after samir. Can you drop a short root-cause hypothesis for postmortem?
samir (on-call): RCH: staggered rollout left signer node serving old JWKS; clients saw kid mismatch. Contributing factors: rollout didn't verify JWKS propagation and cache invalidation delay on jwks-cache.
lucy (product): CS message sent. No active escalations from customers at this time. Will reopen thread if customers report new issues.
ops-bot: reminder: create incident ticket and attach logs/snippets.
alex (eng): I'll draft a small follow-up: add a canary check to CI that queries /keys from each region before finalizing the key deployment.
samir (on-call): Marking this thread resolved for now — moving to monitoring. If error rate rises above 5% will re-pager.
maya (sre): Thanks. Filing for postmortem and assigning action items: rollout guard, cache TTL audit, improve observability for jwks propagation.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved by samir (on-call). Duration: 26m. :tada:
